name: messaging.recall-self-text
description: Recall one preflight-verified, signed-in user's plain TEXT message from the verified self P2P chat. expectedText and chatId are bridge-only equality and destination guards; the native desktop recall wire request is exactly {id: messageId}. Acknowledgement is not proof: read the same message until its recalled state is confirmed. No retry after a failed request.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Canonical native int64 message ID from immediate own-message preflight.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Canonical native int64 ID of the signed-in user's verified self P2P chat.

parameters.name: expectedText
parameters.description: Exact plain text decoded from immediate preflight; bridge-only, never sent on the native wire.
